title: Trigonometry: Sine, Cosine and Tangent
seo_title: Trigonometry – JSS 3 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Label the sides of a right-angled triangle; use sine, cosine and tangent to find sides and angles. (summary of the NERDC JSS 3 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 3 maths worksheets on trigonometry: opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse, sin, cos and tan, finding sides and angles in right-angled triangles. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: sin = O/H, cos = A/H, tan = O/A
body_html:
How to think about it

  • The hypotenuse is opposite the right angle. The opposite side is opposite the angle θ. The adjacent side is next to θ.
  • sin θ = opposite ÷ hypotenuse, cos θ = adjacent ÷ hypotenuse, tan θ = opposite ÷ adjacent (SOH CAH TOA).
  • To find an angle, use the inverse: θ = tan⁻¹(opposite ÷ adjacent).

Examples

Example

Hypotenuse 10 cm, angle 30°, find the opposite side

sin 30° = 0.5

Answer: 5 cm

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Mixing up adjacent and hypotenuseThe hypotenuse is always the longest side.
Calculator in radiansUse degrees.
Using sin to find an angleUse sin⁻¹.

items.q: In a right-angled triangle, the adjacent side is 9 cm and the hypotenuse is 15 cm. Which ratio finds the angle?
items.e: SOH: sin = O/H. CAH: cos = A/H. TOA: tan = O/A. With the adjacent side and hypotenuse, use cos (CAH).

items.q: In a right-angled triangle, the opposite side is 9 cm and the adjacent side is 13 cm. Which ratio finds an angle?
items.e: SOH: sin = O/H. CAH: cos = A/H. TOA: tan = O/A. With the opposite side and adjacent side, use tan (TOA).

items.q: Which side is the opposite, relative to the angle θ?
items.e: The opposite side is across from θ: B.

items.q: Which side is the adjacent, relative to the angle θ?
items.e: The adjacent side is next to θ (and is not the hypotenuse): X.
